workItem: I1 (M8 Agent Cutover) Option B: formal design evidence on what a 'real caller' for the claude-code-cli provider profile would have to mean. Concludes two structurally distinct paths exist -- a content-generation-only LLM call inside a Model A work package (buildable, but serves a different, narrower profile without mutating capability) vs. a genuine agentic Claude Code host with real tool access (serves the profile literally, but blocked by the same unresolved tool-call-level authorization mediation gap already documented for Model B). No implementation, no new caller, no code change -- claude-code-cli stays BLOCKED, which this document argues is the structurally correct state, not an open task.
